# 1. Home — https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/

## Bespoke Fly-In Safaris Across Kenya

Skip the long drives. Wild Skies Safaris designs private fly-in journeys to Kenya's iconic reserves and coastal finishers, tailored for unforgettable wildlife encounters and effortless travel.

## Kenya's Premier Safari Routes

Four extraordinary destinations, one seamless fly-in experience. Begin with the wild theatre of the Mara, explore the iconic plains of Amboseli, discover the raw wilderness of Tsavo, then finish on pristine Diani Beach.

- Masai Mara — big cats and the Great Migration
- Amboseli — elephant herds beneath Mount Kilimanjaro
- Tsavo — vast, remote wilderness and red elephants
- Diani Beach — white sand and Indian Ocean relaxation

## The Wild Skies Advantage

### Luxury Fly-In Safaris
Spend less time on the road and more time where it matters: tracking lions at dawn, watching elephants cross open plains and arriving at camp relaxed.

### Expert Local Guides
A great safari is shaped by the people who read the land. Our guides and private hosts bring deep local knowledge, refined hospitality and instinctive tracking skills.

### Seamless Transfers and Logistics
Flights, meet-and-greet service, luggage handling, airstrip transfers, camp coordination and special requests are arranged with calm precision.

### Personalized Itineraries
We tailor each journey around your pace, interests, dietary needs, family dynamics, photography goals, romance, celebration plans and appetite for adventure.

### Exclusive Access
Step beyond the ordinary with private conservancies, intimate camps, night drives where permitted, guided walks and remote luxury stays.

Wild Skies Safaris was created from a deep love of Kenya's landscapes, wildlife and the quiet magic that happens when a journey is crafted with care. We are not here to sell standard tours. We design personal safari experiences shaped by local insight, conservation-minded travel and an instinct for the details that make luxury feel effortless.

From the first conversation to your final sunset in the bush, our role is to listen closely, plan intelligently and open the door to places that feel both extraordinary and deeply personal.

- **When to See the Great Migration in Kenya** — Plan around river crossings, predator activity and the quieter luxury windows on either side of peak season.

# 2. Destinations — https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/destinations.html

## Featured Destinations

Masai Mara, Amboseli, Tsavo and Diani, handpicked for exceptional wildlife and authentic coastal finishers.

### Masai Mara — Big Cats and Migration
Rolling savannahs, incredible predator action and the world-famous Great Migration make the Mara the classic East African safari stage. Expect dramatic river crossings, early-morning game drives and optional hot-air balloon safaris.

### Amboseli — Kilimanjaro Views
Amboseli is synonymous with large elephant herds and stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro. The park's open plains provide exceptional photographic opportunities, especially early and late in the day.

### Tsavo — Vast and Remote
Tsavo's wide-open spaces, dramatic landscapes and iconic red elephants offer a more remote safari experience. Ideal for off-grid camps, night drives and a deeper sense of wilderness.

### Diani Beach — Coastal Finale
White-sand beaches, coral reefs and relaxed coastal lodges. Diani is the perfect way to end a safari, with private villas, snorkelling and serene days beside the Indian Ocean.

---

# 3. Masai Mara — https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/masai-mara.html

Big cats, sweeping savannahs and the Great Migration.

## Overview
Masai Mara National Reserve is Kenya's most celebrated wildlife area. Each year the Mara hosts dramatic concentrations of grazing herbivores and their predators, a living, breathing wildlife spectacle anchored by the seasonal Great Migration of wildebeest and zebra.

## Featured Masai Mara Lodges
- **Angama Mara** — High above the Mara, with sweeping views and intimate lodge hospitality.
- **Mara Serena Safari Lodge** — A classic hilltop base for game drives across the Mara Triangle.
- **JW Marriott Masai Mara** — A refined tented camp experience close to the reserve's wildlife theatre.
- **&Beyond Bateleur Camp** — An intimate camp-inspired stay surrounded by classic Mara scenery.

## What You Will See
- Lions, cheetahs and leopards in open country
- Large herds of wildebeest and zebra during migration
- Birdwatching including raptors and marsh species

## Best Time to Visit
Year-round wildlife viewing is excellent; peak drama is June to October when large-scale migration river crossings occur. For quieter luxury windows, consider November to February.

## How to Get There
Most guests arrive by scheduled or charter light aircraft from Nairobi, a scenic 45 to 60 minute flight to the Mara airstrips followed by a short game-drive transfer to camp.

## Suggested Activities
- Early-morning and late-afternoon game drives
- Balloon safaris at dawn (seasonal)
- Private guided walks in conservancy areas

---

# 4. Amboseli — https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/amboseli.html

Elephant herds framed by the silhouette of Mount Kilimanjaro.

## Overview
Amboseli National Park is famed for its close-up elephant encounters and unrivalled views of Mount Kilimanjaro on clear days. The park's wetlands and dry plains attract diverse wildlife and are ideal for photography.

## Featured Amboseli Lodges
- **Elewana Tortilis Camp** — A spacious, elegant camp with memorable Kilimanjaro views.
- **Amboseli Serena Safari Lodge** — A dependable base beside the park's wildlife-rich wetlands.
- **Ol Tukai Lodge** — A classic lodge setting in the heart of Amboseli's elephant country.
- **Tawi Lodge** — A secluded conservancy stay with a quiet, private safari rhythm.

## What You Will See
- Large, habituated herds of elephants and iconic tuskers
- Birdlife drawn to the marshes and seasonal water sources
- Classic East African predators and plains game

## Best Time to Visit
June to March generally has excellent visibility and wildlife activity. For clearer Kilimanjaro views, plan around the drier months.

## How to Get There
Fly-in options from Nairobi are commonly used; driving from Nairobi is also possible (approximately 4 to 5 hours) and offers scenic highland views en route.

## Suggested Activities
- Guided game drives timed for Kilimanjaro photography
- Visit local Maasai communities (responsibly and by arrangement)
- Birding walks around marshy areas

---

# 5. Tsavo — https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/tsavo.html

Immense landscapes, red earth and iconic tuskers.

## Overview
Tsavo is one of Kenya's largest parks, split into Tsavo East and Tsavo West. Its raw, wide-open landscapes and striking geology, along with the famous red elephants, create a sense of scale and remoteness.

## Featured Tsavo Lodges
- **Finch Hattons** — A historic luxury camp beside the springs of Tsavo West.
- **Kilaguni Serena Safari Lodge** — A classic Tsavo West lodge overlooking a waterhole.
- **Satao Camp** — A tented camp experience immersed in Tsavo East wilderness.
- **Severin Safari Camp** — A peaceful base for exploring Tsavo's red-earth landscapes.

## What You Will See
- Red-dust elephants and large mixed herbivore herds
- Lava flows, river gorges and baobab trees
- Opportunities for night drives and walking safaris in select areas

## Best Time to Visit
Wildlife viewing is good year-round; the drier months (June to October) concentrate game near water sources.

## How to Get There
Fly-in charters from Nairobi are the most efficient way to access remote camps; driving is possible but distances are long and roads can be rough.

## Suggested Activities
- Full-day wilderness drives and photographic safaris
- Guided walks and conservancy experiences
- Visit Mzima Springs (Tsavo West) and scenic viewpoints

---

# 6. Diani Beach — https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/diani.html

White sands, warm Indian Ocean waters and relaxed coastal luxury.

## Overview
Diani Beach is a stretch of powder-white sand on Kenya's southern coast. Close to coral reefs, forested islands and intimate coastal lodges, it offers a calm and restorative counterpoint to the intensity of the bush.

## Featured Diani Stays
- **Almanara Luxury Resort** — Private villas, attentive service and a relaxed beachfront setting.
- **The Maji Beach Boutique Hotel** — An intimate boutique retreat designed for slow coastal days.
- **Swahili Beach Resort** — Swahili-inspired architecture, gardens and Indian Ocean access.
- **Kinondo Kwetu** — A characterful, low-key coastal hideaway for a more private escape.
- **Neptune Beach Resort** — A luxurious beachfront retreat with stunning ocean views.
- **Baobab Beach Resort** — A serene beachfront lodge surrounded by lush gardens and swaying palms.

## What You Will Do
- Snorkeling and coral reef exploration
- Private beach dinners and boat trips
- Relaxation in secluded villas and boutique resorts

## Best Time to Visit
December to March and July to October are especially pleasant; the coast is warm year-round with short rains in April to May.

## How to Get There
Fly from Nairobi to Diani's Ukunda airstrip or combine with a private transfer from inland safaris; a short domestic flight completes the bush-to-beach transition.

## Additional featured safaris

### 3-Night Masai Mara Fly-In Safari (Peak Migration Season)
3 nights / 4 days. Travel period 28 to 31 August. 3 passengers (2 adults and 1 child aged 12). Mara Serena Safari Lodge. Routing Wilson to Mara Serena and return to Wilson.

Day 1: Check in at Nairobi Wilson Airport at least 1 hour before departure. Scheduled flight over the Great Rift Valley to Mara Serena Airstrip. Met by your professional safari guide in a private 4x4 Land Cruiser. Introductory game drive en route to Mara Serena Safari Lodge. Lunch overlooking the Mara Plains. Afternoon private game drive in the Mara Triangle. Dinner and overnight.
Day 2: Early morning private game drive when predators and plains game are most active. Hot breakfast at the lodge. Mid-day at leisure — pool, spa, lodge facilities. Lunch. Afternoon private game drive through sunset seeking lions, leopards and wildebeest herds. Dinner and overnight.
Day 3: Breakfast, then an extensive full-day game drive along the Mara River with your private 4x4 Land Cruiser. Option of a bush picnic lunch. Prime opportunities to observe the Big Five, cheetahs, crocodiles and seasonal migration movements. Return to the lodge for dinner and overnight.
Day 4: Breakfast and check-out. Transfer to Mara Serena Airstrip with final game viewing en route. Scheduled flight back to Wilson Airport, Nairobi.

Includes: return scheduled flights Wilson to Mara Serena; 3 nights at Mara Serena Safari Lodge; full board meals; exclusive private 4x4 game drives with dedicated guide; Masai Mara National Reserve park entry fees; all return airstrip transfers in the Mara; all mandatory government taxes and local levies.
Excludes: soft drinks and alcoholic beverages unless specified; comprehensive travel and medical insurance; driver/guide gratuities and tips; personal expenses, laundry and souvenirs; international flight tickets to and from Kenya.

Total package investment: USD 6,900, all-inclusive for 2 adults and 1 child aged 12, including all taxes and fees.

# 9. Blog — https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/blog.html

## Safari Notes and Travel Inspiration

### When to See the Great Migration in Kenya
Wildlife timing. Plan around river crossings and predator peaks; the timing shifts annually, so the best window depends on rainfall, movement and reserve conditions. For many travelers, the magic is not only in seeing the herds but in pairing them with the right lodge and guiding style.

Our specialists tailor this to your preferred pace, whether you want the most dramatic river crossings or a calmer, more luxurious stay with excellent wildlife viewing.

### Why Fly-In Safaris Change Everything
Travel insight. Flying between camps maximizes wildlife time and minimizes transit fatigue. Instead of spending long hours on the road, you arrive refreshed and ready for early game drives, evening sundowners and a smoother start to each day.

For families, honeymooners and photographers, that efficiency often becomes the difference between a stressful trip and a deeply immersive one.

### The Art of Ending at Diani Beach
Coastal finale. Pairing the savannah's rhythm with coastal relaxation creates an ideal recovery day and private beach experience. It gives the journey a natural rhythm: exhilaration in the bush, softness on the Indian Ocean, and time to linger in the luxury of both.

For many guests, a Diani finish is the perfect counterpoint to a high-energy safari, offering calm, privacy and a beautiful final chapter.

# 11. Frequently asked questions (site-wide)

**What is Wild Skies Safaris?**
A Kenya-based luxury tour operator that designs and operates private, tailor-made fly-in safaris across the Masai Mara, Amboseli, Tsavo and Diani Beach.

**Where is Wild Skies Safaris located?**
Nairobi and Mombasa, Kenya. Business hours are Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 18:00 East Africa Time.

**What is a fly-in safari?**
A safari where light aircraft replace long road transfers between camps, reserves and the coast. Guests fly from Nairobi Wilson Airport to bush airstrips in 45 to 60 minutes and begin game viewing almost immediately.

**Which destinations are covered?**
Masai Mara National Reserve, Amboseli National Park, Tsavo East National Park, Tsavo West National Park and Diani Beach, with Nairobi Wilson Airport as the main fly-in departure point.

**When is the best time to see the Great Migration in the Masai Mara?**
Peak drama is generally June to October, with river crossings most likely between July and September. The exact timing varies each year with rainfall and herd movement; November to February offers quieter luxury windows with excellent resident wildlife.

**When is the best time to visit Amboseli?**
June to March offers excellent visibility and wildlife activity. The drier months give the clearest views of Mount Kilimanjaro.

**When is the best time to visit Tsavo?**
Wildlife viewing is good year-round, with the drier months from June to October concentrating game around water sources.

**When is the best time to visit Diani Beach?**
December to March and July to October are especially pleasant. The coast is warm year-round, with short rains typically in April and May.

**How do guests reach the Masai Mara?**
By scheduled or charter light aircraft from Nairobi Wilson Airport — a scenic 45 to 60 minute flight to a Mara airstrip, then a short game-drive transfer to camp.

**What is the baggage limit on domestic safari flights?**
15 kg per passenger in soft-sided bags, including hand luggage.

**Are itineraries customisable?**
Yes. Every itinerary is private and can be adjusted for dates, pace, interests, dietary requirements, family dynamics, photography goals, romance or celebrations.

**How long is a typical safari?**
Published packages range from 2 nights for a honeymoon escape to 11 nights for The Signature Reserve.

**What is the price range?**
Published packages run from approximately USD 3,850 per couple for a 2-night honeymoon escape to USD 15,200 per couple for the 6-night land-only Amboseli and Maasai Mara safari. All prices are indicative and subject to availability and season.

**Can a safari be combined with a beach holiday?**
Yes. Diani Beach on the Indian Ocean is the standard coastal finisher, reached by direct flight from the Mara or via Nairobi.

**What is included in a typical package?**
Domestic light-aircraft flights where the routing specifies fly-in travel, airstrip and lodge transfers, accommodation, meals as specified, private 4x4 game drives with an expert guide and applicable park entry fees. International flights, travel insurance, gratuities and personal expenses are normally excluded.

**How do I book?**
Use the enquiry form at https://www.wildskiessafaris.com/contact.html, email info@wildskiessafaris.com, call +254 728 223 861, or message WhatsApp at https://wa.me/254728223861.
